blocks.tamil_translation: I got down only for Salah and to relieve myself,” he said. The Prophet ﷺ said, “You have (by standing guard tonight, through the great grace of Allah Ta'ala) made Jannah obligatory for yourself. Therefore, even if you do no other (Nafl) deed after this deed (of standing guard), there is no loss for you.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَائِذٍ ﵁ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ فِي جَنَازَةِ رَجُلٍ فَلَمَّا وُضِعَ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ: لَا تُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ! فَإِنَّهُ رَجُلٌ فَاجِرٌ فَالْتَفَتَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ إِلَي النَّاسِ فَقَالَ: هَلْ رَآهُ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ عَلي عَمَلِ اْلإِسْلَامِ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ: نَعَمْ يَارَسُولَ اللهِ، حَرَسَ لَيْلَةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ، فَصَلَّي عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ وَحَثَي التُّرَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَقَالَ: أَصْحَابُكَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn A'idh (RA) narrates, “The Prophet ﷺ came out to lead the Janazah Salah of a man. When the Janazah was placed down, Hazrat Umar ibn al-Khattab (RA) said, “O Rasulullah, do not lead the Janazah Salah for him; he is a sinner.” (Hearing this,) Rasulullah ﷺ turned towards the people and asked, “Has any one of you seen him do any one of the deeds of Islam?” A man said, “Yes, O Rasulullah, one night he stood guard in the path of Allah Ta'ala.” The Prophet ﷺ led his Janazah Salah and also put soil into his grave. After that (facing the deceased) he said, “Your companions think that you are one of the people of Jahannam, and I bear witness that you are one of the people of Jannah.”
